title: [bug] rpl_stack three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent fails on main: root did not accept the relayed leaf announce
description: lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:1792 assertion 'root did not accept the relayed leaf announce' fails on pre-existing main (verified at commit 1cd8b86784, before any ow1e.111.7 changes). ROOT-DRAIN debug output shows root receiving None for relayed announce. Likely related to announce relay or lichen-link NOT_FOR_US destination filter commit e9d823f006 ('mirror Python NOT_FOR_US destination filter in Rust receive') or l2 same-callback rearm 73b0348eb3. Reproduce: cargo test -p lichen-node three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent
close_reason: Already fixed on main. Reproduced the exact failure (tests.rs:1790 'root did not accept the relayed leaf announce', ROOT-DRAIN None) at reported commit 1cd8b86784 in a clean worktree. Manual bisect with per-commit target dirs: FAILS at 8dc3c1aadd, PASSES at its child 38f88112ab ('chore(beads): worker5 sync') and at every later commit incl. current HEAD 028c87991c (3/3 stable runs). Fixing diff: 38f88112ab removed a duplicated bounded-drain loop in three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent (tests.rs:1762-1783) left by a chimeric merge — the duplicate loop drained the relayed leaf announce before the asserting drain, so root_outcome stayed None. Also removed a stale DIO-echo drain before relay DAO. Same repair family as afdbe39243. Suspects e9d823f006/73b0348eb3 are both ancestors of 1cd8 and are NOT the cause. No code change needed this round.
